query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN subfamily = 'TPS-a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as tps_a,
       SUM(CASE WHEN subfamily = 'TPS-b' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as tps_b,
       SUM(CASE WHEN subfamily = 'TPS-c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as tps_c,
       SUM(CASE WHEN subfamily = 'TPS-e/f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as tps_ef,
       SUM(CASE WHEN subfamily = 'TPS-g' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as tps_g
FROM tps_genes;
